title: Unlocking Burst A
eyebrow: Choice for aj · nothing changed yet

short.lead: Your approvals for Burst A never reached the Focus Deck lock. This session now runs your messages from the /home/user folder, which is not a git repo, so the plugin drops the approvals without a word. The lock also refuses any hand edit, so I cannot record them for you. Both ways out need a new session.
short.hint: Tap a step to see what it changes and what it needs from you.
items: docs/5-today/Today.md on the triage branch says where everything stands, so a fresh session can pick up from it.
Filed as the plugin issue "Design-loop approvals are dropped silently" (Ajw2003/AjsClaudeCodeTools#296).
Choose one of the two routes under Choices.

choices: How should Burst A get unlocked?
Start a new session on the Focus Deck repo, lock on
There you type "Design approved: Burst A"; I create the build-step issues and log the plan; then you type "Build plan approved: Burst A".
Turn the lock off, then start a new session

In the cloud environment menu in the session's title bar, choose Edit and add the environment variable HOUSE_RULES_LOOP with the value off. It applies to every new session in that environment, with no stage checks.
Both need a new session, so option A (lock on) costs no more and keeps the stage checks you set up.

wrapup.summary: A choice of how to unlock Burst A after this session's approvals were dropped.
wrapup.blocking: Your choice of route, and a new session.
wrapup.next: Either way, Burst A is built in the new session, starting from the handoff note.
